en: Take your time. The sea will still be here.
Vermilion City, in Kanto! The S.S. Aqua makes the crossing in no time. A Champion of the League sails as our guest.
Right this way. She's waiting at the quay.
The S.S. Aqua is at the quay. Or is it Hoenn you're after?
Go right on through. She sails whenever you're ready.
The S.S. Aqua sails to Vermilion City in Kanto, but she only carries those the League has named Champion.
Win at the Indigo Plateau, and you'll be welcome aboard.
